points.statement: The paper presents an integrated microscope that images several sensing-relevant parameters across a diamond plate.
points.quote: Here we demonstrate an "all-in-one QDM" that can image several parameters relevant to NV ensemble sensing across a millimeter diamond plate, including NV spin resonance lineshift, decoherence, depolarization time scales, stress/strain, and birefringence.

points.statement: Excitation can be switched between two optical paths by a movable mirror, offering focused and full-sample illumination.
points.quote: Two optical excitation pathways are exchanged by use of a flipper mirror, with an epifluorescent option and a non-focused full-sample excitation option.

points.statement: The apparatus is configurable among several measurement modalities.
points.quote: The all-in-one QDM is configurable between multiple measurement modalities, as listed in Table 1.

points.statement: Combining these options allows both point and imaged measurements to be collected and correlated.
points.quote: This combination of options affords great flexibility: e.g., the all-in-one QDM can collect and correlate confocal and imaged NV measurements.

points.statement: A light source and polarization filters can be switched into the optical paths to make a transmission measurement of birefringence.
points.quote: An LED with linear polarization control and appropriate circular polarization filter can be switched for the top objective and bottom filters, respectively, to create a transmission measurement of optical birefringence using the same below-sample objective and camera.
